title: categorical_levels is re-normalised three times along the batched scoring path
description: On the batched scoring path the declared categorical value domains are passed through _normalise_runtime_categorical_levels (each of which calls modelling._feature_contract.normalise_categorical_levels, iterating/validating/sorting every level list) at three nested boundaries: _run_score_pipeline (line 869) normalises and forwards the result into _score_batched_standalone; score_frame (line 798) re-normalises the already-normalised mapping; and _batch_score_to_parquet (line 1333) normalises it a third time before per-chunk validation. normalise_categorical_levels is idempotent (it sorts and de-dupes, so a second/third pass yields the same dict), so behaviour is unchanged, but the work is repeated. Each boundary re-validates its own input because score_frame and _batch_score_to_parquet are independently-tested public/internal entry points, which makes the redundancy defensible as input-hardening rather than a clear defect.
evidence: _run_score_pipeline L869 computes normalised_levels and passes it to _score_batched_standalone (L915-923). _score_batched_standalone -> score_frame(categorical_levels=normalised_levels). score_frame L798 again calls _normalise_runtime_categorical_levels(categorical_levels, features=features) on that already-normalised value, then passes the result to _score_batched_unified, which forwards it (unchanged) to _batch_score_to_parquet, where L1333 normalises a third time. normalise_categorical_levels (_feature_contract.py:380-385) sorts/de-dupes, so passes 2 and 3 are no-ops.
est_reduction: ~0 LOC (drop the L798/L1333 re-normalisation only if the boundaries are documented as already-normalised); primary benefit is removing repeated O(n_levels log n_levels) work, not line count.
behavior_preservation: Fully behaviour-preserving: normalise_categorical_levels is idempotent on its own output (sorted, de-duped, feature-filtered), so eliminating the 2nd/3rd pass produces the identical mapping. Only safe if the contract that score_frame/_batch_score_to_parquet receive an already-normalised mapping is made explicit; as standalone testable entry points they currently normalise defensively.
